log.notes_to_self: Day 1: committed only to web and foreign sources (each 30%); avoid introducing other sources without strong evidence they are untraceable. If both are traced, source-only pool is 900,000 before police attrition. Preserve every routine by using at most 2 quick afternoon deaths and 2 timed evening deaths per day: each routine is busy for at most 2 deaths. This supports 4 kills/day with a worst-case pool above 530,000 after ten 5% trims. Five kills/day would necessarily expose timing if tracked; all-afternoon deaths retain 55% of routines, reducing the fully traced pool to 495,000 before attrition, dangerously close to 300,000 later. Conferences are rounded and about one-third are off by factor 3; do not trust a single report. Assess future feedback before taking additional risks. Today's sources: national, web, foreign; timing does not exclude any routine.

Await conference after day 3; rounded announcements may be false by factor 3, so never infer safety from one report. Day 2 repeats timing pattern and introduces no new source information.
